offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based software and outsourced revenue cycle services to physician practices, hospitals and health systems. It delivers these through subscriptions and service contracts that handle billing, coding, claims and practice management.

primary_products.value: practice management software; electronic health record software; patient engagement software; medical billing analytics

primary_services.value: revenue cycle management; medical billing and coding; claims processing; credentialing; consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: physician practices, hospitals, health systems, ambulatory surgery centers

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly software subscriptions paid by practices and hospitals; service fees: billing and collection services, often priced as a percentage of collections

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud software sold to providers, hosting their clinical and financial workflows; service provider: outsourced billing and revenue cycle work for healthcare providers

geography_served.value: US national: Customers across the United States, with offshore operations supporting US clients

specialization.value: related lines: revenue cycle services, EHR and practice management software, patient engagement tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to physician groups and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA privacy and security rules and ONC certification requirements for health IT
